notes: The appositional *even* is `added`: rule 16 licenses such a word only on a phrase an object marker stands on, and this clause has no marker at all.

The italic *are they* is given to אֲשֶׁר as its supplied antecedent (rule 46's first rider) plus the clause's construction-supplied copula (rule 20), rather than being split between an `added` pronoun and a copula elsewhere.

הִיא takes only the determiner *this* here, because הָאָרֶץ is written and supplies *land*; the article is left `unrepresented` under rule 41's limit. This differs from vv. 3, 7 and 11 only because there no noun stands beside the pronoun.
